name: Andrew Campbell-Fraser
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi, I’m Andrew — Welcome to All the difference, based in Eltham VIC, serving people throughout Nillumbik and beyond. I offer: - Counselling — for adults, one-on-one - Psychotherapy — for adults, one-on-one - Skills development — including the DBT-informed Skills for life program - Group facilitation — including a Men’s circle and facilitation for organisations I hold a PACFA-accredited Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy (Holistic Practice), Metavision Institute and specialist training through the Association of Psychological Therapies UK/Australia My registration is PACFA Reg. This includes complex trauma (cPTSD).

name: Sarah Sacks
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I offer grounded, thoughtful therapy for people navigating the ups and downs of life. Relationships, anxiety, depression, grief, loss, parenting, trauma, and neurodivergence are all areas that I support my clients to grow within everyday. As an experienced therapist, I tailor the the experience to meet where you are at.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Karthika Neduveli
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am have been a Counselling Practitioner since 2005. I have received a Level I and II Complex trauma Certification. My practice involves in depth work with anxiety, depression and trauma.

name: Bodhi Priti
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My way of working is within a client-centred approach, to help deepen understandings of the challenges that bring you to therapy along with your hopes and goals. My work draws upon many frameworks, that include a developmental and trauma-informed lens, attachment theory, feminism, emotion focused approaches and family therapy. I bring an understanding of ourselves as multi-faceted humans that informs a soul centred approach.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Derek Goodlake
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As an experienced Counsellor, EMDR Practitioner and a Clinical Hypnotherapist, I can work with you to be all you can be. I work holistically with clients, utilising whatever therapies are appropriate. Two clients with the same presenting issues may have very different underlying cause, e.g. anxiety and depression may be work related or from past trauma amongst other causes and need different therapy.

name: Kate McMahon
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m a warm, gentle and creative therapist in Melbourne, dedicated to helping you find joy, ease and strength during difficult times, and supporting you to find new ways of understanding through creative approaches. I draw on gestalt, somatic and creative arts therapies to support you in this journey. I am a Registered Music Therapist, and a Registered Clinical Counsellor, offering a supportive space for making sense of your experiences in more ways than words.

name: David Cronin
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: David has been providing counselling, therapeutic group work, and mental health and wellbeing education to individuals, couples, and organisations for over twenty years. David has over 5000 hours of counselling experience, helping people with a wide range of presenting issues such as anxiety, depression, grief and loss, trauma, and complex relational, developmental and behavioural challenges. Working in the humanistic tradition David strives to help people find or regain their personal agency and self-compassion with a view to them living their best life.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Kim Storey
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.
